screen.wotn.node.root.description: The core of the Leviathan Axe mastery tree.
screen.wotn.node.throw.description: Throw the axe, freeze targets and call the weapon back to your hand.
screen.wotn.node.quick_return.descriptio: A future modifier that will reduce the axe return time.
screen.wotn.node.imbue.description: Channel frost through the blade and temporarily empower every strike.
screen.wotn.node.deep_freeze.description: A future passive that will intensify the weapon's freezing power.
screen.wotn.node.spikes.description: Strike the ground and summon a widening formation of spikes before you.
screen.wotn.node.glacial_reach.descripti: A future modifier that will extend the range and area of the spikes.
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.name: Alfrigg
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.greeting: The cold ruins common steel. Fortunately, I do not work with common steel. What do you need?
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.open_forge: I want to see the forge.
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.ask_runes: What do you know about these runes?
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.about: I have worked for kings, gods, and men who thought themselves both. These days, I prefer weapons that do not lie.
dialogue.wotn.blacksmith.runes: A rune does not create power. It teaches the metal to remember the power it already holds.
dialogue.wotn.common.back: I want to ask something else.
dialogue.wotn.requirement.leviathan: Requires the Leviathan Axe in your inventory
screen.wotn.mastery.no_eligible_weapons: No compatible weapon was found in your inventory.
screen.wotn.mastery.empty_description: Bring a weapon that can receive runic upgrades so the blacksmith can reveal its mastery tree.
dialogue.wotn.alchemist.name: Kvasir
dialogue.wotn.alchemist.greeting: Every substance holds a memory. Bring me the right reagents and enough time to listen.
dialogue.wotn.alchemist.open_alchemy: I want to study your formulas.
dialogue.wotn.alchemist.research: Leave the reagents with me and return later. A rushed discovery usually ends in smoke, or something worse.
screen.wotn.alchemy.title: ALCHEMY OF THE NORTH
screen.wotn.alchemy.recipes.empty: RESEARCH A FORMULA TO UNLOCK BREWING.
screen.wotn.alchemy.orders.title: ALCHEMIST ORDERS
screen.wotn.alchemy.orders.description: Narrative orders will arrive with the quest system. Research and brewing are already available.
screen.wotn.alchemy.message.cannot_brew: NOT ENOUGH REAGENTS OR INVENTORY SPACE
screen.wotn.alchemy.description.jormunga: Empowers every strike with stacking venom and grants resistance to poison.
screen.wotn.alchemy.description.fenrir: A ferocious mixture that amplifies physical power and awakens ancestral hunting instincts.
screen.wotn.alchemy.description.niflheim: Amplifies glacial damage and shields the drinker from fire.
screen.wotn.alchemy.description.idunn: A golden elixir inspired by Iðunn's fruit. Its effects will be defined later.
screen.wotn.alchemy.discovery_hint.jormu: Kvasir suspects a venomous creature carries the first trace of this formula.
screen.wotn.alchemy.discovery_hint.fenri: Only a preserved sample from Fenrir can reveal this mixture's memory.
screen.wotn.alchemy.discovery_hint.niflh: Bring something touched by natural frost to begin the Niflheim investigation.
screen.wotn.alchemy.discovery_hint.idunn: A fruit tied to the North and Yggdrasil may reveal this elixir's principle.
screen.wotn.alchemy.message.already_disc: THIS FORMULA HAS ALREADY BEEN REVEALED
screen.wotn.alchemy.message.missing_samp: THE REQUIRED SAMPLE IS NOT IN YOUR INVENTORY
screen.wotn.alchemy.message.formula_disc: NEW PROJECT REVEALED IN THE GRIMOIRE
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.jormungandr: Shortens duration in exchange for stronger poison.
Will add weakness or slowness to the main toxin.
Will spread a reduced toxin to nearby enemies.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.fenrir.ragi: Trades duration for a greater burst of physical power.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.fenrir.hunt: Will add speed and awareness of wounded targets.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.fenrir.alph: Will share part of the benefit with nearby allies.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.niflheim.de: Converts duration into stronger glacial protection.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.niflheim.wi: Will add projectile resistance or concealment in snow.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.niflheim.st: Will create a defensive reaction after critical damage.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.idunn.conce: Turns gradual healing into greater immediate recovery.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.idunn.golde: Will add lasting regeneration after the initial healing.
screen.wotn.alchemy.modifier.idunn.orcha: Will heal or strengthen allies in a small area.
screen.wotn.alchemy.milestone.1.descript: Learn your first formula and establish Kvasir's grimoire.
screen.wotn.alchemy.milestone.3.descript: Unlocks batch brewing for three potions.
screen.wotn.alchemy.milestone.6.descript: Reserved milestone for catalysts and alchemical combinations.
screen.wotn.alchemy.milestone.12.descrip: Completes the grimoire and prepares the final narrative reward.

screen.wotn.alchemy.message.ingredient_c: THIS COMPONENT HAS ALREADY BEEN FULLY STUDIED
screen.wotn.alchemy.message.missing_ingr: YOU DO NOT HAVE THIS SAMPLE
message.wotn.alchemy.analysis_complete: Kvasir has completed the analysis of your submitted batch.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.jormungandr.1: An animal toxin reacts with burned matter and requires a stable container.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.jormungandr.2: The known formula must be fermented and exposed to luminous energy.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.jormungandr.3: An advanced toxin requires spectral matter and a stabilizing core.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.fenrir.1: A Fenrir sample needs animal vitality and heat to reveal its memory.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.fenrir.2: Prepared blood can be intensified with flesh and Nether fire.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.fenrir.3: The advanced essence reacts with magma and a rare mineral stabilizer.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.niflheim.1: Natural frost needs a blue mineral and a vessel capable of preserving it.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.niflheim.2: The initial essence reacts with compressed ice and crystalline resonance.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.niflheim.3: Only the densest ice and a stable core can contain primordial cold.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.idunn.1: A northern fruit needs sweetness and a vessel to preserve its vitality.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.idunn.2: The first elixir can be enriched with more fruit and pure gold.
screen.wotn.alchemy.hint.idunn.3: The advanced formula requires fruit, a golden apple, and a stabilizing core.
message.wotn.alchemy.progress_reset: Your alchemy progress has been completely reset.
screen.wotn.alchemy.niflheim.special.whi: Mist builds 5 levels; the next pulse freezes.
screen.wotn.alchemy.niflheim.special.rim: Ice skills stack slowness on targets.
screen.wotn.alchemy.niflheim.special.abs: Hits build 5 levels; the next hit freezes.
message.wotn.alchemy.all_unlocked: All alchemy formulas have been unlocked for this player.

item.wotn.rune_renewal_seed: Rune of the Seed of Renewal
tooltip.wotn.rune.glacial_duration: Adds 60 seconds to the essence duration.
tooltip.wotn.rune.frost_mist: Creates a mist that slows nearby enemies.
tooltip.wotn.rune.whiteout: Pulses build Frost I-V; another pulse at level V freezes for 3 seconds.
tooltip.wotn.rune.rime_mark: Attacks dealing at least 2 damage build Frost I-V, reducing speed by 10% per level.
tooltip.wotn.rune.absolute_zero: Another hit at level V freezes for 3 seconds and resets buildup.
tooltip.wotn.rune.feral_duration: Adds 60 seconds to Fenrir Blood duration.
tooltip.wotn.rune.feral_power: Per rune: +6% attack damage and +4% attack speed.
tooltip.wotn.rune.predatory_instinct: Marks Prey. Within 32 blocks, grants +20% movement; below 40% health, it takes +20% melee damage.
tooltip.wotn.rune.wild_hunt: Prey kills heal 25%, hasten and chain the hunt; melee execution rises to +25%.
tooltip.wotn.rune.feral_blood: Melee damage builds up to 5 Fury. At maximum: +20% attack speed, +15% movement and +10% knockback resistance.
tooltip.wotn.rune.chainbreaker: Every 8s, maximum Fury repeats the next hit's damage in an area and consumes all stacks.
tooltip.wotn.rune.golden_duration: Adds 60 seconds to Iðunn Elixir duration.
tooltip.wotn.rune.golden_power: Per rune: +6% healing received and +2 HP maximum health.
tooltip.wotn.rune.orchards_grace: Emits periodic pulses that heal nearby allies.
tooltip.wotn.rune.golden_bloom: Every third pulse cleanses and grants absorption.
tooltip.wotn.rune.renewal_seed: Restores the bearer once at critical health.
tooltip.wotn.rune.serpentine_duration: Adds 60 seconds to Jörmungandr Venom duration.
tooltip.wotn.rune.serpentine_power: Per rune: +15% venom damage and +15% poison resistance.
tooltip.wotn.rune.corrosive_fangs: Each toxin stack reduces the target's armor.
tooltip.wotn.rune.serpent_rupture: Detonates maximum stacks as immediate venom damage.
tooltip.wotn.rune.serpentine_miasma: Intoxicated targets release miasma on death.
tooltip.wotn.rune.world_coil: Transfers stacks and allows one additional propagation.
